---
title: "Session 5 · Getting data into R"
subtitle: "Files, import checks, dates, and export choices"
---

## Learning goals

Import a delimited file, document parsing and missing-value rules, audit the
result immediately, parse dates, recognize common non-delimited formats, and
choose an appropriate export format. Inspect header location, duplicate names,
exported row counters, and spreadsheet formatting before importing. Record a data-file
checksum in the report and use saved objects or workspaces deliberately.

The main slides use synthetic worksheet illustrations to identify layout
problems before showing code. Compressed CSV files and `data.table::fread()`
receive brief introductions. More technical details follow the summary in an
optional reference section.

## Materials

- [Slides](slides.qmd)
- [Guided lab](lab.qmd)
- Lab starter—choose one: `starter/import-lab.Rmd` or `starter/import-lab.qmd`
- Synthetic teaching files used in the slides: `data/`

Copy your chosen starter from the course clone to
`BIOS6301-mywork/work/session05/` and open your personal project. Base `read.csv()` and
`readr::read_csv()` are shown side by side; either is acceptable when the import
contract and checks are explicit. The files under `data/` are synthetic and may
be inspected or reused for independent practice.
